平方完成した厳密CIR遷移を、標準正規Rと独立χ²(Nf−1)のSから作ります。同じRでglobal αの符号を決め、Nf=1ではS=0。単位方向と新しい半径からpを再構成し、極小KでKnew/Kを作りません。K=0は方向が未定義として拒否します。 Kˉ=NfT2,c=e−h/τ,A=T(1−c)2,R∼N(0,1), Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations. Assumptions, units and boundaries kB=1, T=1.3, tau=0.5, h=0.2, 65536 independent replicas. Test three initial energies at each of three degree counts. No Hamiltonian force, positions, constraints or center-of-mass removal. Adopted numerical method Use the completed-square exact CIR transition with normal R and independent chi-square(Nf−1) S. The same R sets the sign of global alpha; S=0 for Nf=1. Reconstruct momentum from its unit direction and new radius without a tiny-K energy ratio. Reject K=0 because its direction is undefined. A separate noiseless mean-relaxation control demonstrates loss of fluctuations. Verification limits and failures A bath diagnostic, not another independent physical problem. Correct K sampling does not thermalize momentum directions by global scaling alone. The bath-only exp(−t/tau) identity is not a full-MD kinetic ACF. Statistical decisions apply to fixed seeds/budgets, not general mixing guarantees. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
